term: grades imply a maximum at the supplied esse respect
definition: At the supplied esse respect, existence of a pair related by MoreIn entails existence of an in-act individual with no greater individual in that same respect. No other respect is constrained.
note: Explicit unattributed OPEN restriction of the existing all-respects grades-to-maximum interface; no order law, positive grade, actual-world existence or uniqueness is built in.
